plain: A pirate or private raider on the seas.

webster.text: A pirate; one who cruises or scours the ocean, with an armed vessel, without a commission from any prince or state, to seize and plunder merchantmen.

example.quote: Thus preferring the immediate advantages of a few African corsairs to the lasting interests of the American states, and to the rights of human nature, deeply wounded by this infamous practice.
example.cite: Thomas Jefferson, A Summary View of the Rights of British America, 1774
